title: Concepts Used in the ASRA-NFM Implementation
abstract: ASRA-NFM is an adaptive neuro-symbolic reasoning architecture for learning world models, solving unfamiliar interactive environments, and running autonomous machine-learning experiments. This note catalogs the core concepts that structure the system: object-centric states, transition-based world modeling, action-semantics discovery, causal intervention, symbolic rule induction, hypothesis-driven exploration, multi-timescale memory, and bounded autonomous experimentation.
